name: Cyber Runners
summary: These are neon couriers in black armour. It seems like there is more than data behind their glowing visors ...
legend: When the city's grid goes dark at midnight, the Cyber Runners come out. They are couriers in matte black armour, and each helmet is split by a single burning visor. They carry data no network dares to hold. Glitch Runner leads the pack, with cyan light bleeding through magenta seams. Void Hacker follows in violet and electric yellow, slipping through firewalls like smoke. Behind them, Data Ghost flickers red and white, there one frame and gone the next. No one knows who sends the packages, or who receives them. The checkered panels on their arms hum with code no one has cracked. Rumour says the runners never stop, because something is chasing them through the wires. And tonight, for the first time, the signal behind them is getting closer...

skins.name: Glitch Runner
skins.story: The pack's leader, whose cyan visor stutters through magenta seams, never runs the same route twice.

skins.name: Neon Sprint
skins.story: A blur of toxic green inside hot-pink frames, Neon Sprint delivers before the message has even been sent.

skins.name: Void Hacker
skins.story: Violet code glows behind electric yellow plating as Void Hacker slips through firewalls like smoke.

skins.name: Pulse Courier
skins.story: Wrapped in ice-blue trim, Pulse Courier carries packets that beat like an orange heart behind the visor.

skins.name: Data Ghost
skins.story: Red-framed and flickering white, Data Ghost shows up in one frame and is gone in the next.

skins.name: Quantum Jumper
skins.story: Deep blue light pulses inside lime-green armour; Quantum Jumper lands on rooftops he never seemed to leap toward.

skins.name: Firewall Breaker
skins.story: Crimson visor burning inside a cyan frame, Firewall Breaker smashes through every barrier the city builds.

skins.name: Circuit Phantom
skins.story: Gold circuits shimmer beneath violet plating, tracing paths that vanish once the Phantom has passed.

skins.name: Static Striker
skins.story: Silver-grey static crackles behind a cobalt-blue frame, scrambling every camera Static Striker runs past.

skins.name: Binary Blade
skins.story: Hot-pink edges and green ones-and-zeros flash across Binary Blade's armour, sharp enough to split a signal in two.

versions.note: The grid goes dark and the first ten Cyber Runners light up the night, each visor glowing with its own stolen colour. Their first delivery has begun.

versions.title: Rooftop Relay

skins.name: Crest Dash
skins.story: His hot-pink crest is the last thing the rooftop drones see before he drops three floors and vanishes into the lime-lit alleys.

skins.name: Parcel Bolt
skins.story: She has carried a thousand amber parcels across the rooftops and never lost a single one, not even with the red alarms on her heels.

skins.name: Rail Grinder
skins.story: He grinds the old tram rails between the towers on mint-lit skates, goggles pushed up so the wind can never hide the city from him.

versions.note: The runners take the city from above: a punk with a burning crest, a courier who has never lost a parcel and a skater who grinds the old rails between the towers.

versions.title: Smog District

skins.name: Smog Filter
skins.story: He runs where the air turns green, and the yellow filters on his mask are the only reason he always makes it back.

skins.name: Wire Locks
skins.story: Her hair is a bundle of fibre-optic cables, and every magenta tip blinks when she pulls another secret out of the city network.

skins.name: Iron Grin
skins.story: He lost his jaw in a street fight and forged a chrome one, and now his grin glows as hot as the furnace in his chest.

versions.note: Below the bright towers lies the smog district, and its runners glow just as hard: a scavenger who breathes through filters, a girl wired into the city network and a brawler with an iron grin.

versions.title: Overdrive Night

skins.name: Apex Rider
skins.story: Number 07 has won the Overdrive race four times, and nobody has ever seen the face behind the azure visor.

skins.name: Volt Medic
skins.story: She patches up crashed runners at full speed, and the heartbeat on her mask glows aqua for as long as theirs keeps going.

skins.name: Silent Collar
skins.story: Nobody knows who pays him; he just turns up his indigo collar, tips his hat, and the race always ends the way he planned.

versions.note: Once a year the whole city turns into a race track: a rider nobody has seen without a helmet, a medic who keeps the runners going and a silent fixer who decides how the race ends.

logoPrompt: Square logo: a single blocky Minecraft-style cyber courier in matte black armour, boxy helmet framed in hot magenta with a wide glowing cyan stripe visor, cyan checkered side panel on the helmet, cyan and magenta light strips on chest, arms and boots, dramatic neon glow and rim light, dark navy background with faint digital haze, NO text.
coverPrompt: Wide cinematic cover: three blocky Minecraft-style cyber runners side by side in matte black armour with boxy helmets and stripe visors. Left: magenta frame with a glowing cyan visor and cyan lights. Centre: electric yellow frame with a glowing purple visor and purple lights. Right: red frame with a glowing white-grey visor and silver lights. Checkered neon panels on their arms. Rainy cyberpunk city rooftops at night with neon signs and data streams behind them. Big stylised glowing neon title letters reading "Cyber Runners".
